name: CropVerse
description: A crop marketplace web app connecting farmers and buyers, with email-verified signup, admin account approval, crop listings, price-trend charts and crop disease reports.
context: Built as a DBMS Lab project.

details.overview: CropVerse is a three-role web application. Farmers publish crop listings, buyers browse and purchase them, and an administrator approves new accounts before they can sign in.
features: Signup with an emailed verification code, followed by administrator approval before login
Farmers can create, edit and delete crop listings, view a dashboard summary and alerts, and submit crop disease reports
Buyers can browse the marketplace, purchase crops, view a dashboard and see individual farmers' listings
Price-trend chart pages for both farmers and buyers
Admin dashboard to review pending signups, approve users and view all users
architecture: A static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript frontend, organised by role (admin, buyer, farmer), calls a Node.js and Express REST API.

The API (server/app.js) uses a MySQL connection pool (db.js) and sends verification emails through Nodemailer (mailer.js). The database schema defines eight tables: users, email_otps, crops, crop_listings, transactions, price_trends, disease_reports and alerts.
implementation: Passwords are hashed with bcryptjs and sessions use JSON Web Tokens issued at login.
API routes are protected by a role-checking middleware, so farmer, buyer and admin endpoints are separated.
